title: Do Not Withhold What Is Owed

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Do not take advantage of a hired worker who is poor and needy, whether that worker is a fellow Israelite or a foreigner residing in one of your towns. Pay them their wages each day before sunset, because they are poor and are counting on it. Otherwise they may cry to the Lord against you, and you will be guilty of sin. - Deut 24:14-15 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God commands fair and prompt treatment of hired workers, especially the poor and needy, whether they were fellow Israelites or foreigners. Wages were to be paid each day before sunset, because a poor labourer was counting on that money to feed his family that very day. To delay or withhold his pay could mean his family went hungry. God took this so seriously that He warned the poor worker might cry out to Him, and the employer would be guilty of sin.

Notice how God identifies with the vulnerable worker. He hears the cry of the poor labourer who has been cheated or made to wait. The powerful employer might not think twice about a delayed payment, but God does. He stands as the defender of the worker who has no other advocate. Fair wages, paid promptly, are a matter of justice before God.

This principle is timeless and deeply relevant. God cares about how workers are treated, about fairness, honesty, and promptness in what we owe others. To exploit or cheat those who depend on us is a serious matter in His eyes. The New Testament repeats this warning against those who withhold the wages of their workers (Jas 5:4). Whether we are employers, customers, or simply people who owe others, God calls us to deal justly and promptly, never taking advantage of anyone's need. Are you fair and prompt in what you owe to those who depend on you?

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Are you fair and prompt in what you owe others?
2. How does God's care for workers shape your dealings?
3. Where might you be tempted to take advantage of someone's need?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You hear the cry of the worker and defend the vulnerable. Help me deal justly, honestly, and promptly with all who depend on me. Amen.
